submit_reasoning: The history-only drift model was selected as the best forecast. The series shows a clear downtrend from ~51.6 to ~45.3 over 124 bars. No seasonality was detected (strength 0.0) and no anomalies were flagged. The context events from the article (earnings date, Zacks Hold rating, valuation metrics) were all rejected by the ablation gate, so the event-informed run produced an identical trajectory. The drift model captures the persistent downward trend and projects it forward 33 steps. Support is degraded due to having only 124 observations (132 needed for full calibration), but this is the best available forecast.
